description: About Us Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products. You will operate within a high‑impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long‑term technical strategy and system health. As a hands‑on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide. Responsibilities Define and drive the long‑term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability. Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C‑level and VPs) to shape the medium and long‑term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs. Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability. Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high‑risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi‑system and multi‑country impact. Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.g., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks. Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non‑technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage. Required Qualifications Principal/Staff Engineer level experience or equivalent with an extensive and demonstrable history in architecting and scaling mission‑critical, high‑volume, and low‑latency systems in global fintech or e‑commerce environments. Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands‑on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event‑based architectures. Proven ability to establish and lead the long‑term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups. Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross‑border transactions. History of successfully leading and completing large‑scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact. In‑depth knowledge of credit card/payment systems design is a significant differential. Nice to Have Experience with Clojure or similar functional languages. Proven interest or experience in leveraging AI to optimize engineering workflows. Deep domain knowledge of credit card processing or financial ledgers. Location & Work Model This role is based on a hybrid model at one of our Nubank offices in Brazil (São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte), the United States (Palo Alto, Durham, Washington D.C. or Miami), or Canada (Toronto) . We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos. Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento. Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos. O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara! A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como \"A marca mais amada do Rio\" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a \"Marca preferida dos Cariocas\" . E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão. Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos? We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description: Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil. De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100). Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova. Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço. É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão. Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos: O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente. Atribuições O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar. 2-Técnico de Necropsia O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente. Atribuições O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil. As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais. As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias. Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos. O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso. Atribuições Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso. 5-Delegado de Polícia O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres: Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública; Assegurar a observância da lei; Defender as instituições públicas; Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais; Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais; Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital. Etapas do concurso A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital. O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social. Resumo concurso Perito e Investigador Polícia Civil do Rio O Concurso Perito e Investigador, para o cargo de Auxiliar de Necropsia da Polícia Civil/RJ ,. terá a exigência de nível fundamental e receberá uma remuneração de R$4.743,12. Já para Técnico de Necropsia , é exigido nível médio para o salário de R$5.277,59. O Inspetor dePolícia Civil é necessário nível superior e os aprovados receberão o salário deR$6.280,31. O cargo de Investigador também exige a mesma escolaridade. Para oposto, o salário é de R$5.740,38. A exigência para o cargo de Delegado, no Concurso Perito e Investigador é de nível superior em Direito, devendo com o diploma devidamente registrado para exercer a função com remuneração é de R$18.747,95. Detalhes do concurso Concurso : Perito e Investigador Estado do Rio de Janeiro (PC-RJ) Escolaridade : fundamental, médio e superior #J-18808-Ljbffr

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Data Engineer (SQL DBA) at M3 Global Research , an M3 company. About the Business Unit M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide. M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors. Job Description M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives. Primary DBA Responsibilities Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability. Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency. Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning. Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing. Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance. Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards. Team Responsibilities Participate daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure you are aligned with business needs. Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks. Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives. Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting. Qualifications Competencies: Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery). Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams. Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives. Problem-solving mindset with a strong attention to detail. AI and Automation Expectations Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality. Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation. Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge-case identification. Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability. Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data. Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability). Engagement Model This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full-time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need. We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands-on environment and grow into long-term technical leadership. title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description: About Canonical Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times a year in person in interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing. Technology Focus This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology – from the kernel through userspace. Apply if you are an exceptional Go, Rust or C/C++ engineer and want to work on next‑generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage. Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure are essential for modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro‑service architecture, or cloud infrastructure. Here are some examples of projects underway at Canonical: RustVMM – a new hypervisor for Linux focused on performance, security and operability. Rockcraft – an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community. LXD – a modern system container and virtual machine manager used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms, covering low‑level kernel work, filesystems, VMMs, networking, and higher‑level REST API and CLI. Kubernetes (MicroK8s & Charmed Kubernetes) – building on‑rail K8s, Charmed Kubernetes, and operations tooling. OpenStack (Charmed OpenStack, OVN/OVS, Ceph) – delivering cloud platform technologies to large‑scale computing environments. These teams hire system‑level C/C++, Go, Rust and Python developers to work on security‑critical, performance‑critical and mission‑critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Location We have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone. What You Will Focus On Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach. Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise. Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth. Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product. Collaborate proactively with a distributed team. Write high‑quality code to create new features. Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them. Review code produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. What We Are Looking For in You An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university. Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path. Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations. Experience working on open‑source virtualisation or container technology. Experience working in the kernel or very low‑level system. Professional written and spoken English. Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred). Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability. Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments. Ability to travel twice a year for company events up to two weeks each. Additional Skills We Value Performance engineering and security experience. What We Offer You Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person. Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year. Annual compensation review. Recognition rewards. Annual holiday leave. Maternity and paternity leave. Employee Assistance Programme. Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues. Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Advogado(a) Sr.
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Solid understanding of analog and digital system design: filters, amplifiers, data converters, memory interfaces, and communication protocols. Proficiency in electronic simulation tools and laboratory instrumentation. Experience with LabVIEW and/or MATLAB for data acquisition and system control. Strong problem‑solving skills, self‑motivation, and a collaborative mindset. Previous experience in R&D environments is highly desirable. Native portuguese and Fluent or Advanced English is required. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Especialista em Operações Comerciais
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR) . No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description: Opportunity We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division-level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross-org architectural decisions, negotiate trade-offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high-impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1-click insurance products). Vision and contribution 2026's Vision And (how This Role Contributes). In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data-driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences, (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants, and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations. This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU). Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue. Insurance launches and scales high-quality one-click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture. Core Responsibilities Support defining the division’s technical end-state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade-offs (cost × latency × availability). Co-own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs. Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real-time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX. Drive NuPay ↔ Ads integration for aspirational purchases: real-time underwriting, multi-source funding, take-rate modelling, card-on-file / wallet flows and onboarding for flagship merchants. Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one-click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS). Support one-stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech-debt management to avoid blocking growth. Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle. Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post-mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross-BU initiatives. Represent the division in cross-org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively. Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators. Key business & engineering metrics you will influence NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share-of-checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic. Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch. Insurance: one-click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes. Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners. Challenges And Opportunities (what You’ll Own) World-class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first-layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB). Real-time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low-latency ads decisioning and NuPay real-time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance. One-click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one-click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control. Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC. Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One-Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost-efficient infra. What You’ll Find In The Team High-calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers. Complex, high-impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real-time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi-partner dependencies. Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders. What You’ll Navigate Heavy cross-BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration. Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re-architecture or open-scheme decisions. Dependence on third-party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations. Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics. Trade-offs between accelerating one-stack migration and accepting short-term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente de manutenção
description: O Grupo Seres, em parceria com empresa Industria de Plásticos, seleciona profissional para atuar na função de Gerente de Manutenção Atividades: O Gerente de Manutenção na Indústria PET é o profissional responsável por planejar, gerenciar as atividades de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva dos equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Seu papel é garantir que todas as máquinas e sistemas estejam operando de forma eficiente e segura, contribuindo para a continuidade e a qualidade do processo produtivo. Principais Responsabilidades 1. Gestão da Equipe de Manutenção Coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de manutenção, definindo funções, delegando atividades e garantindo que todos os membros da equipe desempenhem suas funções de forma eficiente. Realizar treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe de manutenção, promovendo a atualização técnica e a melhoria das habilidades operacionais. Monitorar o desempenho da equipe, realizar avaliações periódicas de desempenho e aplicar feedbacks para garantir a melhoria contínua do trabalho. 2. Planejamento e Execução de Manutenção Planejar e implementar o cronograma de manutenção preventiva e corretiva para todos os equipamentos da planta, minimizando paradas não programadas e otimizando a disponibilidade dos ativos. Garantir a execução eficaz das atividades de manutenção, como lubrificação, inspeção, ajustes e substituição de peças de equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Realizar análise crítica de falhas e implementar ações corretivas para evitar a recorrência de problemas operacionais. 3. Gestão de Recursos e Estoque Gerenciar o estoque de peças de reposição e materiais necessários para a manutenção, realizando compras, controle e acompanhamento de inventário de peças e componentes. Trabalhar junto ao setor de compras para garantir a aquisição de peças e materiais de qualidade, dentro dos prazos e com o melhor custo-benefício. Controlar os custos de manutenção, garantindo o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros disponíveis, otimizando os gastos com peças, serviços e mão de obra. 4. Melhoria Contínua e Eficiência Operacional Gerir e analisar indicadores de desempenho de manutenção, como o tempo médio entre falhas (MTBF) e o tempo médio para reparo (MTTR), e propor melhorias nos processos. Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos de manutenção, utilizando ferramentas de gestão, como o PM (Planejamento de Manutenção) e o TPM (Manutenção Produtiva Total). Colaborar com outras áreas da produção para entender as necessidades específicas de cada linha e otimizar o uso dos equipamentos. 5. Gestão de Projetos e Inovações Tecnológicas Coordenar projetos de melhorias ou expansão de instalações, equipamentos e sistemas, implementando novas tecnologias ou modernizações nos processos de manutenção. Acompanhar a instalação de novos equipamentos e garantir que os processos de manutenção sejam adequados desde a fase de implantação. Implementar tecnologias de manutenção preditiva, como monitoramento remoto de equipamentos e análise de dados para identificar falhas antes que ocorram. 6. Segurança no Trabalho e Conformidade Regulatória Garantir que todos os procedimentos de manutenção sigam rigorosamente as normas de segurança do trabalho e as regulamentações ambientais aplicáveis. Promover a cultura de segurança, realizando treinamentos sobre o uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e procedimentos de segurança. Realizar inspeções regulares nas instalações para garantir que todos os sistemas e equipamentos estejam operando dentro dos parâmetros de segurança e conformidade regulatória. 7. Análise de Desempenho e Relatórios Analisar relatórios de desempenho dos equipamentos e sistemas, fornecendo feedback para a equipe de manutenção e a gestão da fábrica. Preparar relatórios periódicos sobre o desempenho da manutenção, incluindo indicadores como custos, tempo de inatividade, e eficiência dos serviços prestados. Apresentar relatórios para a diretoria e outras áreas da empresa, propondo ações para resolver problemas de manutenção e melhorar a performance da planta. 8. Gestão de Contratos e Fornecedores Gerenciar contratos de serviços terceirizados relacionados à manutenção, como fornecedores de peças, consultorias ou serviços especializados. Negociar prazos, custos e condições com fornecedores, garantindo a qualidade e a entrega pontual dos serviços e materiais necessários para a manutenção da planta. Avaliar a performance dos fornecedores, garantindo que atendam aos padrões exigidos pela empresa. Profundo conhecimento em processos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, além de experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (como CMMS). Conhecimento em gestão de equipes, controle de custos e planejamento de manutenção. Familiaridade com as normas de segurança industrial, regulamentações ambientais e boas práticas de manutenção. Noções de controle de estoque e gestão de fornecedores. Habilidades Liderança e gestão de equipes, com foco em desenvolvimento, motivação e resultados. Capacidade de análise crítica e tomada de decisões rápidas em situações de emergência. Habilidade em gestão de projetos, com foco na melhoria contínua dos processos. Excelente comunicação, tanto para reportar resultados para a direção quanto para interagir com as equipes de produção e outros departamentos. Habilidade para trabalhar com indicadores de desempenho e ferramentas de análise de dados. Características Pessoais Proatividade e visão estratégica, com foco em otimizar processos e reduzir custos. Forte senso de organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas atividades simultaneamente. Comprometimento com a segurança e qualidade em todas as etapas da manutenção. Espírito de liderança e habilidade para motivar a equipe a alcançar as metas estabelecidas. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brasil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. Your Profile Education Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements Fluent in Portuguese and English Right to work in Brazil Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description: Senior Manager, Ceremonies Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Mecânico Diesel
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Sua missão: Elaborar planos e executar manutenções. Substituir peças, reparar e testar desempenho de componentes e sistema de veículos. Efetuar diagnósticos e reparos em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos. Realizar serviços de lubrificação dos veículos. Requisitos: Ensino Médio Completo. Experiência na função. Informática Básica. Atuação em concessionária e formação em técnica em Mecânica Diesel, Mecatrônica e afins, será um diferencial. Vantagens/Benefícios: Ticket Alimentação-pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família. Assistência Médica-cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama. Assistência Odontológica-cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família. Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral-proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente; Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação; Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade; Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho. Esperamos que você tenha: Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica. Registro no conselho de Classe. Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses. Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos. Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia. title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR). Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Sua missão será monitorar projetos de uma gerência de Infraestrutura de TI, com foco na criação de métodos, controles, artefatos e apontamento de riscos e impeditivos para cumprimento dos prazos e budget. Essa é uma oportunidade PJ no modelo presencial no Rio de Janeiro. Responsabilidades e atribuições Como Gerente de Projetos de Infraestrutura de TI, você focará em: Monitorar projetos de adequações de infraestrutura de TI, desde a concepção até a entrega, utilizando metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de gerenciamento de projetos. Estruturar metodologia para acompanhamento dos projetos de infraestrutura de TI. Definir e acompanhar o plano do projeto, identificando os recursos necessários, estabelecendo metas e monitorando o progresso. Garantir a comunicação eficaz entre todas as partes interessadas, mantendo todos os envolvidos informados sobre o status do projeto. Identificar e gerenciar os riscos dos projetos, implementando planos de mitigação quando necessário. Realizar a gestão financeira dos projetos, garantindo que os custos estejam dentro do orçamento aprovado. Desenvolver e entregar relatórios regulares sobre o progresso do projeto e os principais indicadores de desempenho. Requisitos e qualificações Como requisitos básicos, buscamos: Formação superior em cursos de tecnologia da informação. Experiência profissional mínima de 03 anos, comprovadas, em funções de gerente de projetos. Experiência profissional na aplicação de metodologia tradicional e ágil. Experiência em construção de templates de apresentações executivas. Comunicação assertiva e capacidade de remoção de impedimentos. Experiência com projetos de infraestrutura de TI. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Technical Account Manager
description: Description We're growing and looking to hire a Technical Account Manager who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity. Claroty is a global leader in cyber‑physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast‑growing, award‑winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity. About The Role As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will serve as a strategic technical partner to our enterprise customers, ensuring successful deployment, adoption, and ongoing value realization from Claroty’s platform. You will bridge the gap between customers and internal teams, driving technical alignment, proactive optimization, and long‑term relationship success. This is a high‑impact, customer‑facing role ideal for a strong networking professional who thrives at the intersection of technology, strategy, and customer engagement. Responsibilities Partner with customers to plan, design, deploy, and configure Claroty’s solutions to meet their technical and business objectives while driving measurable value. Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers, owning all technical requirements and ensuring alignment with best practices. Provide ongoing technical guidance, architecture recommendations, and optimization strategies to maximize product adoption and performance. Proactively identify risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement across customer environments. Translate customer feedback, industry trends, and field insights into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams. Develop technical artifacts, documentation, playbooks, and best practices to streamline deployments and enhance service delivery. Support escalations and complex technical scenarios in partnership with Support and R&D teams. Drive executive‑level technical conversations and present strategic roadmaps aligned with customers’ cybersecurity and operational objectives. Travel up to 30% to support on‑site engagements, workshops, and strategic meetings. Requirements 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Network Engineering, or similar customer‑facing technical roles. Deep knowledge of IT networking; prior experience as a Network Architect is highly beneficial. Strong understanding of networking standards and protocols, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and segmentation principles. Experience with Operational Technology (OT) environments and industrial networks – a strong advantage. Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure network architecture. Network and Cybersecurity Certifications (CCNA, Security+) are a plus. Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) – required. Additional languages, such as Spanish, are a plus. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders. Customer‑centric mindset with the ability to build trusted, long‑term partnerships. Candidates should be comfortable with on‑site work 5 days a week in Rio de Janeiro. Willingness to travel up to 30%. About Claroty Claroty has redefined cyber‑physical systems (CPS) protection with an unrivaled industry‑centric platform built to secure mission‑critical infrastructure. The Claroty Platform provides the deepest asset visibility and the broadest, built‑for‑CPS solution set in the market comprising exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection – whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on‑premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Backed by award‑winning threat research and a breadth of technology alliances, the Claroty Platform enables organizations to effectively reduce CPS risk, with the fastest time‑to‑value and lower total cost of ownership. Our solutions are deployed by over 1,000 organizations at thousands of sites across all seven continents. Claroty is an equal‑opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of all diverse backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Suporte Pleno CLT
description: Contexto O Tech Stop é o balcão de TI e experiência workplace nos hubs da empresa, com foco em alta disponibilidade (modelo com mínimo de dois analistas nos hubs principais para cobrir pausas e continuidade), integração com fila presencial e tickets (Jira Service Management), incluindo fluxos de autoatendimento (ex.: kiosk) que criam e enriquecem chamados sem substituir o atendimento humano. No desenho do TechCenter em Packs , este papel está no Pack 3 — TechStop / Workplace : atendimento presencial e ambiente físico de trabalho, com interface aos Packs de dados e backlog , modelo de filas e atendimento (Pack 5), onboarding presencial (Pack 4) e escalonamento técnico quando o caso sai do escopo imediato de balcão/L1 (Pack 2 — Engineering Interface / L2). Missão Garantir primeira intervenção humana de qualidade nos chamados de nível 1 e no balcão Tech Stop , com triagem correta , boa experiência do colaborador no hub e cumprimento de SLAs , sabendo quando escalar para times especializados ou L2. Principais responsabilidades Atendimento presencial (Tech Stop): fila no balcão, chamadas ordenadas, registro e encerramento adequados no ticket, comunicação clara com o solicitante. Atendimento L1 (remoto e presencial): diagnóstico inicial, execução de runbooks, orientação passo a passo e resolução dentro do escopo L1; quando aplicável, continuidade após camadas automáticas de orientação ( L0,5 ), sem confundir distribuição (L0) com atendimento humano . Workplace e hardware de escritório: notebooks/desktops, periféricos, impressoras e suprimentos no contexto do hub, monitores e cabos, solicitações de equipamento no escopo acordado. Conectividade no workplace: telefonia (chips, ativações, políticas operacionais em coordenação com stakeholders), modem (triagem, troca, tickets). Grab & Go e estoque operacional: reposição, contagem, movimentações registradas conforme procedimento; apoio a compras operacionais de suprimentos/gadgets no escopo workplace. Descarte e eletrônicos: seguir processos de levantamento, descarte e conformidade quando previstos no hub. Onboarding no balcão: entrega de kits, orientação inicial e fluxo de Onboarding ligado ao kiosk/painel quando for o caso. Documentação e qualidade: uso de base de conhecimento, comentários no ticket que permitam métricas e auditoria; colaboração com melhoria de scripts, categorias e modelo de atendimento. Escalonamento: casos fora do escopo presencial/L1 imediato ou que exigem profundidade técnica → interface com L2/Eng (Pack 2), mantendo contexto e criticidade corretos no chamado. Indicadores e forma de trabalho (referência interna) Operação orientada a TMA , CSAT e SLAs de primeira resposta/atendimento; volumetria típica com forte componente L1 (remoto/presencial) e parcela de Office Tickets (hardware/ambiente físico), além de atividades de backoffice (estoque, logística, impressoras, telefonia, facilities correlatas, automações operacionais) que não aparecem só como ticket — o papel exige visão de fila + piso . Em hubs com cobertura acima do mínimo, o time pode rotacionar entre foco Tech Stop e foco fila L1 (modelo de dimensionamento/capacidade descrito no repositório). Requisitos Experiência sólida em service desk / L1 ou suporte presencial em ambiente corporativo. Inglês para leitura e conversação (desejável espanhol em operações multi-país; materiais de kiosk e fluxos costumam ser PT/EN/ES). Familiaridade com ITSM (Jira Service Management ou similar), identidade corporativa (ex.: Okta) e bom registro em chamado. Comunicação clara, postura de serviço e organização em ambiente de alta demanda. Capacidade de seguir runbooks , checklists e políticas de equipamento/DMP quando aplicável. Desejáveis Experiência com workplace : impressão (ex.: PaperCut em contexto hub), telefonia móvel corporativa , inventário/estoque. Conhecimento básico de rede/Wi‑Fi , SO corporativo (macOS conforme padrão da empresa) e troubleshooting de periféricos. Participação prévia em operação multi-hub ou fusos coordenados. O que valorizamos Accountability no ticket (triagem correta, menos reabertura). Colaboração com onboarding, facilities e engenharia na fronteira certa do problema. Melhoria contínua de processo, documentação e experiência no balcão. #J-18808-Ljbffr
